description: Casa Don Juan first started as a leather handbag shop in the heart of Benidorm Old Town. Then in 1995 Yvonne and Tjeerd were the first owners and that is when Casa
paragraphs: Casa Don Juan is situated near Benidorm’s premier beaches and in the heart of Benidorm Old Town. It offers functional and contemporary accommodations with upscale accents, such as tile flooring and wall hangings. Air-conditioning, television, electric kettle and tea set along with refrigerator and balcony are provided in every room. A wardrobe and private bathroom with a hairdryer and a safe are also included.

We provide all of our guests with free Wi-Fi access. Our maid provides a daily cleaning service. There are no dining services offered, but the downstairs area contains a bar with cafe-style arrangement. Tapas restaurants, grocery shops, and pubs are located throughout the Old Town district
